def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    ordinary_income = 150000
    ordinary_expenses = 120000
    short_term_gain = 12000
    short_term_loss = 18000
    long_term_gain = 5000
    long_term_loss = 9000
    capital_loss_deduction_limit = 3000

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    net_ordinary_gain = ordinary_income - ordinary_expenses
    net_short_term_capital = short_term_gain - short_term_loss
    net_long_term_capital = long_term_gain - long_term_loss
    net_capital = net_short_term_capital + net_long_term_capital

    allowable_capital_loss_deduction = min(
        abs(net_capital), capital_loss_deduction_limit
    ) if net_capital < 0 else net_capital

    net_overall_gain = net_ordinary_gain - allowable_capital_loss_deduction

    # return answer
    return round(net_overall_gain)
